answer: Cross-epoch behaviour ledger: each identity must keep a continuous thread of actions across epochs, and any identity whose new-epoch pattern diverges beyond a fixed threshold is frozen until a consistency audit clears it. An attacker cannot create a fresh nebula of identities without each one surviving that audit and reproducing its prior profile next epoch. Each fake identity must pay one independent audit plus one full epoch of non-repeating task work, with a yarrow marker recorded per cleared identity.
